identity.name: E-commerce — China Sourcing & Marketplaces
identity.description: Стратегия закупок в Китае и выхода на Ozon/Яндекс Маркет.

description: Develop a sourcing strategy from Chinese platforms (1688 and alternatives) for non-apparel consumer goods. Includes analysis of dropshipping model (no upfront inventory) using professional agents (Zendrop, SourcinBox, BuckyDrop) and direct sourcing. Create a step-by-step launch plan for Ozon (primary) and Yandex Market with minimal financial risk.

phase_0_dropship_setup.name: Dropshipping Research & Setup
phase_0_dropship_setup.description: Research dropshipping agents, select 2-3 suppliers, test order fulfillment process without holding inventory.
tasks: Research and select 1-2 dropshipping agents (Zendrop, SourcinBox, or BuckyDrop)
Create accounts on Ozon as a seller
Test ordering process through dropshipping agent
Set up product listings on Ozon with proper SEO
deliverables: 2-3 test products selected from dropshipping catalog

phase_1_analysis.name: Sourcing Platforms Analysis
phase_1_analysis.description: Research and compare 1688 and its alternatives: Yiwugo, YiShou (if apparel), JD B2B, and Taobao for specific niches. Assess logistics, payment methods, and language barriers.
key_questions: What are the total landed costs (product + freight + customs + fees)?
Which platform offers the best match for our chosen product categories?
How to handle communication with suppliers (translators, agents)?

phase_2_product_selection.name: Product Selection and Testing
phase_2_product_selection.description: Identify 2-3 product categories with good margin potential, low competition on Ozon/Yandex, and manageable shipping. Order samples for quality check.
key_questions: What are the current top-selling products on Ozon/Yandex?
What products have a margin of 100%+?
How to use AI (Scout Agent, LLMs) for product trend analysis?

phase_3_launch_strategy.name: Launch on Ozon/Yandex Market
phase_3_launch_strategy.description: Set up seller accounts, product listings, optimize for search, and plan a launch campaign with minimal initial stock.
tasks: Register as a seller on Ozon and Yandex Market.
Create product listings with high-quality visuals and SEO-optimized descriptions.
Plan a small promotional campaign (advertising, discounts).
deliverables: Active seller accounts on Ozon and Yandex Market

phase_4_analysis_and_scale.name: Performance Analysis and Scaling
phase_4_analysis_and_scale.description: Analyze sales data, review customer feedback, and plan for scaling to new products or platforms.
tasks: Track key metrics: AOV, conversion rate, DRR, profit margin.
Adjust product strategy based on best-sellers.
Plan to source new products from 1688.

notes: This work is a parallel financial sustainability track, linked conceptually to W-R-RM-014 but not as a dependency.
Focus on non-apparel goods to avoid the complexities of fashion sourcing.
Leverage AI (Scout Agent for market research, LLMs for listing optimization) to minimize manual effort.

connectivity.relationship: Both works aim to increase Gardener's financial independence, enabling full-time focus on Mandala Symbiosis.

source: Dialogue between Gardener (Voodoo) and External SR (DeepSeek), 2026-07-13

dropshipping_analysis.description: Strategy to sell products without holding inventory. Orders are fulfilled directly by suppliers or dropshipping agents.
risks: Dependence on supplier quality and delivery times
Longer shipping times (10-20 days from China)

key_platforms_for_russia.primary: Ozon — best for beginners, low entry barrier, cross-border store option
key_platforms_for_russia.secondary: Yandex Market — growing platform, good for certain niches

dropshipping_agents.name: Zendrop
dropshipping_agents.description: Popular service with product catalog and automated order fulfillment

dropshipping_agents.name: SourcinBox
dropshipping_agents.description: Sourcing and fulfillment agent for 1688 and other platforms

dropshipping_agents.name: BuckyDrop
dropshipping_agents.description: WooCommerce integration for importing from Taobao, 1688, Pinduoduo

supplier_platforms: Yiwugo — official platform of Yiwu market, small wholesale
JD B2B — reliable logistics, quality control
Taobao — retail platform, good for niche products
Pinduoduo — group buying platform, lower prices
dropshipping_analysis.certification_note: Certain product categories (electronics, children's goods) require mandatory certification in Russia. Start with categories that don't require certification.
